BOSS_TELLS.//: Creature tells (approved with the ideas in note 13, 'Parts 4-8, bosses first'; built in the gap-filling after Part 14, 16 October). Every `every` rounds a boss winds up instead of attacking and says what's coming; the round after, if it's held (trapped, netted, stunned, slowed), lost in smoke, or meets a raised shield (Aegis), the move breaks and it's stunned a round -- the right answer beats it. Otherwise the blow lands harder -- `mult` by the boss's ground level ([below, times]: the first bosses gently, a new player has few answers) -- and fighting Defensively braces you for half the extra (`acc` more likely to hit). Each boss its own move and words; `answer` is what the fight suggests. Mage duels have none (a duel is its own thing). Gideon, the very first boss (combat 6, before a player has any answer), doesn't tell: the boss balance test keeps him a fair first fight.

billy.wind: paws the ground and lowers his horns

snapjaw.wind: opens its jaws wide and waits

basilisk.wind: sinks into the earth -- the ground ripples

yeti.wind: beats its chest and roars at the snow above

sphinx.wind: smiles, and gathers itself to spring

kingnile.wind: draws its great tail back through the water

tombguardian.wind: raises its blade over its head

pharaoh.wind: lifts his crook, and the light dims

morvane.wind: opens the Blood Book -- the candles gutter

BOSS_TELLS.answers: a net, a trap, a stun, a slow, smoke or a raised shield -- or fight Defensively to brace
